items.name: b-bastion
items.subject: the BASTION, the beetles' main hall (tier one): a colossal armoured beetle turned into a fortress, its great domed royal-blue shell with brass ribs, black chitin legs and claws gripping a low riveted stone-and-steel plinth, two brass cupola towers and royal-blue banners at its sides.

items.name: b-great-bastion
items.subject: the GREAT BASTION, the beetle main hall at tier two: the colossal armoured beetle fortress grown larger and taller, its royal-blue domed shell with brass ribs, more brass towers and chimneys around it, stairs and banners on a bigger riveted plinth.

items.name: b-elder-bastion
items.subject: the ELDER BASTION, the beetle main hall at tier three: the grandest armoured beetle fortress, a tall royal-blue domed shell crowned by a brass spire and two great curved golden horns rising on either side, black claws gripping a wide plinth with banners.

items.name: b-brood-den
items.subject: the BROOD DEN, the beetles' supply building and network node: a low round building of rounded royal-blue shell segments around a dark steel dome, a brass pressure gauge and a valve wheel on top.

items.name: b-substance-well
items.subject: the SUBSTANCE WELL, built on a deposit of the forest's magic: a round royal-blue and brass base with a tall glass column in its centre where raw violet substance glows and swirls, a copper coil cap on top, faint violet light spilling over the base.

items.name: b-war-lodge
items.subject: the WAR LODGE, the beetles' barracks: a squat riveted fortress block of dark steel and royal-blue plates with brass trim, horned corner towers, a big royal-blue shield crest over a portcullis gate.

items.name: b-shell-forge
items.subject: the SHELL FORGE, the beetles' weapons and armour workshop: a royal-blue domed forge with brass ribs and three brass chimneys, a dark arched furnace mouth with an anvil in front, a quench tank at its side; at rest, no fire.

items.name: b-alembic
items.subject: the ALEMBIC, where beetle specialists learn to handle substance through devices: a tall building of brass retorts, glass flasks and pipes around a central royal-blue domed column topped by a stacked brass spire, on a riveted plinth with banners.

items.name: b-engine-yard
items.subject: the ENGINE YARD, the beetles' machine workshop: a big royal-blue barrel-vaulted hangar roof with brass ribs over an open bay, a brass gear wheel and a crane frame at its side, steel tanks, on a riveted plinth.

items.name: b-hornwatch
items.subject: the HORNWATCH, the beetles' guard tower: a stout round royal-blue and brass tower flanked by two great curved black horns, a brass bolt cannon mounted on top, on a small riveted plinth. Tall in the frame.

items.name: b-ancestor-shrine
items.subject: the ANCESTOR SHRINE, where beetle heroes are called: a tall stepped dark-stone and brass altar holding a huge black ancestral beetle helm-statue in a brass frame, royal-blue banners on brass posts, stairs leading up. Tall in the frame.
